localised_description: The emirs gather before the Sultan. The horde has not yet reached Anatolia, but none doubt that it will. Some urge that the walls of Konya, Kayseri and Sivas be rebuilt in stone; others say the Turkmen of the frontier should be summoned and armed.
Trade along the Anatolian roads grows, but merchants fear bandits and harsh winters. The vizier proposes a chain of great caravanserais, a day's journey apart, built and guarded by the state.
